value: RUN-33 RETRIEVAL ACCEPTANCE, MEASURED ON SELECTION RATHER THAN PRESENCE, ALL 24 FROZEN MANIFEST ROWS. Method: every row was rewound to its manifest pre state with regression_set.py, its object rebuilt, and its `fndiff --ops` signature captured VERBATIM (build/GUNE5D/RG_manifest24_signatures.json); all 24 reproduced their recorded pre_real exactly. BEFORE was not recalled but RE-EXECUTED: the pre-run-33 rule ('share at least one +N/-N opcode mnemonic') is still in the tree as `_signature_tokens`, so both arms were computed from the same captured signatures in one process. CLASS CENSUS of the 24: 13 pure reorder, 7 count-asymmetric, 4 identical-multiset-with-immediates. That 13 matches the PX baseline's 13 pure-reorder rows exactly, which is the cross-check that this capture reproduces PX's population. RESULTS. (1) `laws --residual` SELECTED SET: 18 -> 22 distinct payloads across 24 queries; on the pure-reorder subset alone, 7 -> 11 distinct across 13, and the constant payload that PX measured covering 7 queries is gone (the two residual collisions are PlayerCollidePlayers/sndFxQueUpdate and ScrollMessageBox/getNewPosRectUnique, each pair sharing an instruction band and nothing finer). (2) RANKED ORDER: 24 distinct across 24. (3) `context` similar_residuals: 24 distinct non-empty cohorts across 24, against a measured baseline of 0/24 transferable items. (4) CURE RANK, hand-read from each candidate's own mechanism prose and NEVER from a keyword match: the n=4 pilot moves from 1 HIT / 1 PARTIAL / 2 MISS to 1 HIT / 2 PARTIAL / 1 MISS. PlayerCollidePlayers stays a HIT and now scores through the cure channel rather than the law channel: rank 4 (clear_player) names the scope-versus-colour direction that IS the cure -- its axis_log measured 'declaration moved from function scope into the inner block: REGRESSED, inner-block scope raises a variable's colour' -- and rank 7 (items-extern-literal-sweep) names the cure's other half, replacing a pool-label read with a literal. TowerInit moves MISS -> PARTIAL and its family-level near-hit moves from rank 35 to rank 5. ExtractYPR stays PARTIAL. AtreeNodeInsert stays a MISS: its cohort is only 18 rows and is crowded by same-TU siblings at strength 0.0, and the one law that does name its mechanism (claim.law.dead-local-identity-reuse-flips-callee-saved-coloring.20260831.v1) is not surfaced. HONEST BOUND ON THE WHOLE RESULT: the large gain is SELECTION and family separation, not cure ranking. Cure-hit rate moved by one PARTIAL on n=4, which is not a significant sample; the 24-row cure-rank scoring was not done because it requires a hand read of 24 x 8 mechanism payloads. A future PX-style lane should score cure rank on all 24 before treating the cure channel as proven.
